name: Loop over a list of items
description: Learn how a Loop repeats steps for every item in a list. The workflow gets 10 sample products from the free DummyJSON API, loops over them, logs each product under $20 and writes a summary when the loop is done. It runs with one click and needs no connection.
shortDescription: Learn how a Loop repeats steps for every item in a list.
keyFeatures: Loop over a list returned by an earlier step
Use the current item inside the loop with ${loop_1.item}
Combine a Loop with a Condition to act only on some items
Run a step once after the loop has finished
idealFor: First-time ByteChef users who want to learn how to process a list of records one by one.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Test in the workflow editor.
Get 10 products: an HTTP GET to the free DummyJSON API returns 10 products with a title and a price.
For each product: a Loop goes through ${httpClient_1.products} one product at a time.
Is it under $20?: inside the loop, a Condition checks ${loop_1.item.price}; for cheap products the Logger writes the title and price.
Log a summary: after the loop, the Logger writes how many products were checked.
